decisions.statement: The arc is a full ring less the backlog measured against a recent period's intake.
The color comes from how many items are left against the thresholds the feed sends.
A feed sending no thresholds has the ring colored by the fraction instead.
A ring colored by fraction draws blue at full and green at three quarters.
A ring colored by fraction draws yellow at a half and red at a quarter.
A ring colored by fraction draws black under a quarter.
A backlog of nothing draws an emoji in place of the ring.
The words for nothing left sit beneath that emoji or are left unsaid.

definition: how near done a body of work is
